answer: As prospecting agents wander across the tundra, buyers of quartz assay reports can audit a random 10% of reports, rather than a fixed number per seller. Require a separate locked bond for every report; an independently verified fabrication forfeits that bond. Set the bond above ten times the maximum gain from a fake report, so expected forfeiture exceeds that gain. Splitting reports among many aliases then cannot dilute the audit probability. This relies on unpredictable sampling, reliable audits, and bonds held until checks finish.
